units.source_text: 岛村默默寻思：这种虚伪的麻木不仁是危险的，它是一种寡廉鲜耻的表现。

en.t: Shimamura silently thought: this false, callous numbness was dangerous; it was a sign of shamelessness.

units.source_text: 在按摩女回去以后，他就随便躺下了。

en.t: After the masseuse went back, he lay down casually.

units.source_text: 他觉得一股凉意悄悄地爬上了心头，这才发现窗户仍旧打开着。

en.t: He felt a chill quietly creeping into his heart, and only then realized that the window was still open.
